label: Donut Chart
description: A whole split into its parts, drawn as a sweep: each segment arcs round after the last while its share counts up in the legend; the centre holds the total (or the highlighted share). Brand hue family, not a rainbow; highlight keeps one segment in full color and quiets the rest. Legend beside the ring, or under it in a tall box.

segments.label: Segments: {label, value, color?, display? (legend text override)}

highlight.label: Index of the segment that matters (the centre shows its share)

theme.label: Ink theme; omit to follow the measured scene ground

at.label: Seconds into the scene it enters (default 0.2)
